1.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
1.asv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity Than he that is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

2.web: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge; nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
2.asv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; And he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

3.web: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
3.asv: The foolishness of man subverteth his way; And his heart fretteth against Jehovah.

4.web: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
4.asv: Wealth addeth many friends; But the poor is separated from his friend.

5.web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
5.asv: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall not escape.

6.web: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
6.asv: Many will entreat the favor of the liberal man; And every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

7.web: All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
7.asv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: How much more do his friends go far from him! He pursueth them with words, but they are gone.

8.web: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
8.asv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: He that keepeth understanding shall find good.

9.web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
9.asv: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall perish.

10.web: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
10.asv: Delicate living is not seemly for a fool; Much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

11.web: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
11.asv: The discretion of a man maketh him slow to anger; And it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

12.web: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
12.asv: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; But his favor is as dew upon the grass.

13.web: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
13.asv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father; And the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

14.web: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
14.asv: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers; But a prudent wife is from Jehovah.

15.web: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
15.asv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; And the idle soul shall suffer hunger.

16.web: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
16.asv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; But he that is careless of his ways shall die.

17.web: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
17.asv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto Jehovah, And his good deed will he pay him again.

18.web: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
18.asv: Chasten thy son, seeing there is hope; And set not thy heart on his destruction.

19.web: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
19.asv: A man of great wrath shall bear the penalty; For if thou deliver him, thou must do it yet again.

20.web: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
20.asv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, That thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

21.web: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
21.asv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; But the counsel of Jehovah, that shall stand.

22.web: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
22.asv: That which maketh a man to be desired is his kindness; And a poor man is better than a liar.

23.web: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
23.asv: The fear of Jehovahtendethto life; And hethat hath itshall abide satisfied; He shall not be visited with evil.

24.web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
24.asv: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

25.web: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
25.asv: Smite a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; And reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

26.web: He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
26.asv: He that doeth violence to his father, and chaseth away his mother, Is a son that causeth shame and bringeth reproach.

27.web: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
27.asv: Cease, my son, to hear instruction Onlyto err from the words of knowledge.

28.web: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
28.asv: A worthless witness mocketh at justice; And the mouth of the wicked swalloweth iniquity.

29.web: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
29.asv: Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And stripes for the back of fools.
